LESSON: KUANDIKA 8.3.1 VIAKIFISHI MTAJO

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi mtajo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi mtajo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua matumizi ya alama za mtajo na mshazari katika matini
2. kutumia alama za mtajo na mshazari ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua matumizi ya alama za mtajo na mshazari katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua matumizi ya alama za mtajo na mshazari katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia alama za mtajo na mshazari ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia alama za mtajo na mshazari ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi mtajo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi mtajo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi mtajo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi mtajo.
4. Show that you can: kutambua matumizi ya alama za mtajo na mshazari katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi mtajo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 8.3.1 Viakifishi mtajo important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua matumizi ya alama za mtajo na mshazari katika matini
2. kutumia alama za mtajo na mshazari ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
